verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents that its public RESTful API is the same interface its official SDKs use to report errors, exceptions, deploys and messages, and says explicitly that it can be used to create notifiers for additional languages. A community ecosystem of extra SDKs exists, scoped post_client_item tokens are dedicated to sending events, and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 spec covers the API. Missing for 10: the pack never shows the item-ingestion endpoint or payload schema itself, and there is no independent hands-on report of a custom client successfully sending events.
